turns.text: Hi there! How's it going today?

turns.text: Ugh, the place I booked for tonight just cancelled on me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's frustrating. Do you want me to find the same kind of food somewhere else, or treat it as a chance to try something different?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, someone's here. Don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Census officer, you haven't returned your form yet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, didn't I? Can I fill it in online?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Yes, the code's on this letter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So where did we leave it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right. About that cancelled booking, replace it like for like, or go somewhere new?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Same food. I've been craving Italian all day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it. Look for a trattoria that takes walk-ins, and get there before seven.
